\begin{lemma}\label{lem:count}
There are exactly 42 admissible configurations.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
One can verify this by an exhaustive check over the finite set.
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}\label{lem:checked}
The discriminant is positive.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
A direct calculation confirms it:
\begin{verbatim}
>>> import sympy; sympy.discriminant(x**2 - 3*x + 1) > 0
True
\end{verbatim}
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:fin}
The classification is complete.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
By Lemma 1 and Lemma 2 the enumeration is exhaustive.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
